''See also: [[Malice Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|[[Akura Malice]] is the powerful [[Queen]] of the [[Akura clan]] and a figure of immense Authority{{!}}authority. A practitioner of a pure [[shadow Path]], she utilizes [[Forger]] and [[Ruler techniques]], viewing her [[madra]] as an ideal combination of utility and strength. While she is known for creating the The Book of Eternal Night{{!}}Book of Eternal Night—an idealized version of her [[Path]]—she does not actually possess a Book herself. Her personality is characterized by a desire for control, a tendency toward tyranny and spite, and a willingness to use manipulation or even betrayal to maintain the status quo. She is driven by a belief that the world is best preserved in its current state, even if it requires extreme [[sacrifice]] or the preservation of threats like the [[Dreadgods]] to secure her own power. Malice has a complex and often harsh relationship with her descendants, including [[Fury]], [[Charity]], and [[Mercy]]. She is known to be a demanding leader who values control over affection and has been known to punish her own kin publicly. Her history is marked by early tragedy, as her original family was destroyed when she was an infant, leading her to grow up fueled by a desire for vengeance. In combat, she is a formidable force capable of continent-shattering displays of power, such as summoning massive Shadow{{!}}shadow [[constructs]] or wielding immense archery skills. She is viewed by many as a looming threat, embodying the concept of malice through her mercilessness toward those who oppose her.}}

== Appearance ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|Malice is a [[Monarch]] with black hair, purple eyes, and a wide, crazed smile. She typically wears [[amethyst armor]] or purple armor, though she has been seen in dark blue, and is often accompanied by a cloud of violet essence. Her aesthetic favors foreboding purple and black, and she has been described as having an amethyst hand or a crystal hand emerging from her chest.}}

== Personality ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|As [[the Queen]] of the [[Akura clan]], Malice is a powerful ruler who values useless conversation and has shown amusement during battle. She is willing to [[sacrifice]] her children, including [[Fury]], Akura Pride{{!}}Pride, and [[Mercy]], for the good of her family. Her temperament can range from cold wrath to a treatment of others that has been described as treating them like [[worms]] on a hook.}}

== Abilities ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|A [[Soulsmith]] and [[Monarch]], Malice utilizes [[shadow madra]] to create webs, transport herself, and launch techniques like the [[Dark Tide Incantation]]. She wields a crystalline bow that can transform into a staff, capable of firing volleys of arrows made of ice, Shadow{{!}}shadow, or forged [[blue madra]] that can turn the sky black. Her diverse skills include using Spiritual pressure{{!}}spiritual pressure, opening void spaces via a small black ball, and manifesting a royal specter through an [[Enforcer technique]].}}

=== {{spoiler|book=cradle-11-dreadgod|Moongrave founder}} ===
{{spoiler|book=cradle-11-dreadgod|During her time as the founder of [[Moongrave]] over four hundred years ago, Malice sponsored various camps located in the [[Sacred Valley]].<ref name="cradle-11-dreadgod-c3">''Dreadgod'', chapter 3</ref><ref name="cradle-11-dreadgod-c8">''Dreadgod'', chapter 8</ref> She provided [[Lindon]] with information regarding the connection between [[Monarchs]] and [[Dreadgods]] before utilizing shadows to transport herself.<ref name="cradle-11-dreadgod-c5">''Dreadgod'', chapter 5</ref><ref name="cradle-11-dreadgod-c6">''Dreadgod'', chapter 6</ref> This black-haired figure possesses [[bloodline armor]] that bleeds away into purple essence.<ref name="cradle-11-dreadgod-c6" /> Malice carries a prop related to [[Lindon]] and favors a foreboding aesthetic of black and purple.<ref name="cradle-11-dreadgod-c7">''Dreadgod'', chapter 7</ref><ref name="cradle-11-dreadgod-c12">''Dreadgod'', chapter 12</ref> While [[Charity]] worries about the consequences of enraging her, Malice has released [[Lindon]] from his pain.<ref name="cradle-11-dreadgod-c10">''Dreadgod'', chapter 10</ref><ref name="cradle-11-dreadgod-c12" /> A powerful combatant whose strike rivals the energy of [[Moongrave]]'s launcher construct{{!}}launcher constructs, she wields a bow that transforms into a staff to fire arrows that turn the sky black.<ref name="cradle-11-dreadgod-c15">''Dreadgod'', chapter 15</ref> She can manifest a royal specter through an [[Enforcer technique]] and possesses a [[spiritual perception]] that can pass over an entire city.<ref name="cradle-11-dreadgod-c15" /><ref name="cradle-11-dreadgod-c16">''Dreadgod'', chapter 16</ref>}}

target the [[Twin Star Sect]] and the [[Arelius family]], though she had not yet plundered the [[Dragon Monarch]]'s desert [[vault]].<ref name="cradle-11-dreadgod-c21" /><ref === {{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|The Book of Eternal Night}} ===
{{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|The will and memories of Malice are held within the The Book of Eternal Night{{!}}Book of Eternal Night.<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c7">''Waybound'', chapter 7</ref> While she typically carries a bow, she utilized her armor and summoned the weapon during an attack.<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c8">''Waybound'', chapter 8</ref><ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c9">''Waybound'', chapter 9</ref> Her combat [[technique]] involves [[hunger madra]], which she used to blast a cold star through the air.<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c9" /> She launched an arrow layered with condensed power and various techniques, eventually following up with a volley of arrows.<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c9" /><ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c10">''Waybound'', chapter 10</ref> During the battle, Malice showed amusement and used [[hunger]] echoes of herself and [[Reigan Shen]] to defend against [[Striker techniques]].<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c11">''Waybound'', chapter 11</ref> She treated [[Mercy]] poorly and was perceived by her as a source of hatred, even warning her against attaching a mind-[[spirit]] to her soul.<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c10" /><ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c20">''Waybound'', chapter 20</ref> [[Yerin]] recalls Malice treating her like a worm on a hook, and the entity later felt an intrusion into her [[void space]] when [[Lindon]] punched into her Shadow{{!}}shadow.<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c12">''Waybound'', chapter 12</ref><ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c21">''Waybound'', chapter 21</ref>}}

=== {{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|Dark Castle Audience}} ===
{{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|Seated upon a [[throne]] with shadowy hair, Malice occupies an audience chamber within a dark castle.<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c24">''Waybound'', chapter 24</ref><ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c26">''Waybound'', chapter 26</ref> Her ideal [[Path]] was intended to be contained within the The Book of Eternal Night{{!}}Book of Eternal Night, a [[Path]] that included the [[Strength]], [[Shadow]], and Crown [[Icons]].<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c25">''Waybound'', chapter 25</ref><ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c29">''Waybound'', chapter 29</ref> Lacking a mind-[[spirit]], she possesses the ability to release her [[Netherworld Empress]] and can open both a [[void key]] and a pitch-black [[void space]].<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c26" /><ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c27">''Waybound'', chapter 27</ref> While wearing armor and wielding an ice-blue bow, she also utilizes a solidified [[sword]] of Shadow{{!}}shadow to attack [[Mercy]].<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c26" /><ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c27" /> Malice's power is immense, as she has ruled most of a continent for hundreds of years and possesses the defenses of an earth artist, the strength of a [[sword]] artist, the flexibility of a [[Soulsmith]], and the subtlety of a Shadow{{!}}shadow artist.<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c27" /> She even released shadows that tore apart her own floating castle.<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c26" /> To preserve her own power, she knowingly allowed the [[Dreadgods]] to exist.<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c28">''Waybound'', chapter 28</ref> Malice, who named her family members Akura Justice{{!}}Justice and Akura Pride{{!}}Pride as well as her granddaughter [[Charity]], threatened that no one would remember her daughter's existence after she was finished with her.<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c26" /><ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c29" /> This daughter's armor eventually grew to the size of a [[Dreadgod]].<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c30">''Waybound'', chapter 30</ref>}}
